_meta.method: getComputedStyle(), document.fonts, network/script inspection via headless browser — not guessed from screenshots
_meta.note: Replaces all best-guess values in BLOXCART_SHOPIFY_REBUILD_SPEC.md Section 3

color.price-strikethrough-line: red-500 (~#EF4444) — NOT a CSS text-decoration line-through; it's a separate absolutely-positioned div rotated -12deg overlaid on the grey price text

rarity_colors_CONFIRMED.note: Rarity is per-game free text, NOT a fixed global enum. Colors below are from Murder Mystery 2 only — other games' rarity tiers (Legendary/Rare/Uncommon/Common/mythical for Blox Fruits, Common/secret/og for Steal a Brainrot, etc.) have not had their accent colors individually sampled yet.

families_CONFIRMED.Geist: variable weight 100-900 — body text, h1 hero heading, most product/category page UI
families_CONFIRMED.Poppins: static weights 100-900 loaded — header Log in button and some nav chrome
families_CONFIRMED.Plus Jakarta Sans: variable weight 200-800 — hero CTA button ('Explore games')
families_CONFIRMED.Outfit: static weights 100-900 fully loaded — used somewhere not yet visually located, likely game-card or marketing sections

typography.note: Spec's guess (single family, Poppins/Plus Jakarta Sans/Manrope/Inter) was wrong in kind — site actually mixes 3-4 distinct font families across different UI regions, not one. Confirm Outfit's usage location during Phase 3/4 build.

primary_solid.background: #9D41D9 (flat color, NOT a gradient despite spec's guess)
primary_solid.note: Hero CTA 'Explore games' renders with a visible gradient + drop-shadow/offset 3D look on closer inspection — likely a different, more decorative button variant than the flat in-grid 'Add' buttons. Distinguish these as two button styles during build.

buy_it_now.note: NOT in original spec — confirmed on PDP: a second CTA next to 'Add to cart', green fill, glowing/shadowed, likely Shopify-native express checkout equivalent (Shop Pay / accelerated checkout) worth replicating via Shopify's native buy-now button block.

cards.accent_bar: 4px tall, ~80px wide, centered top edge, rounded-b-full, color = rarity color

breakpoints.note: Not exhaustively probed; mobile (375px) and desktop (1280px) both spot-checked and layouts reflow correctly (hero stacks, game grid collapses to what looks like 2-col on mobile). Tailwind default breakpoints likely in use given class names seen (lg:, md: prefixes observed in captured classNames).
